name: squiggle-sage
description: SquiggleSage - a Firefox-first, local writing assistant.

scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run lint:webext
scripts.lint:webext: npx --yes web-ext lint --source-dir . --warnings-as-errors --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json README.md LICENSE docs/** tests/** test/** scripts/** node_modules/** dist/** .git/** .gitignore plans/** XX-errors/** .firefox-smoke*/**
